title: Approved Signal
style: Alt-pop with punchy four-on-the-floor kick, bright synth stabs, and a tight syncopated bassline; verse stays sparse with close-mic vocals and handclap snaps, pre-chorus lifts with filtered vocal stacks and rising pulse, chorus opens into gang doubles and a chantable hook; bridge drops to half-time with a whispered line and a reversed swell, then final chorus hits wider with delay throws on the anchor phrase. Crisp, glossy mix with strong top-end sparkle., happy, reading
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Corey, I hear it clear
Name it, and it lands
CODA in the front row
Fourward in your hands

[Pre-Chorus]
Near when I call
True when I test
Built from the story
You already blessed

[Chorus]
Approved, approved
CORE CODA FOURWARD ENGINEAR
Approved, approved
That one stays near (stays near)

[Verse 2]
Not a painted mask
Not a hollow shine
It says what it is
And it holds the line

Near when I call

Built from the story

[Chorus]
Approved, approved

Approved, approved

Keep the name alive
Let it ring out clean

[Chorus]
Approved, approved
